item.body: You would expect align to default to start, as on the original shapes. Library shapes default to middle: a start-aligned label in a circle or star looks misplaced. An explicit align still wins.
item.description: Why the library's default alignment differs from the original shapes'.
item.label: New shapes default to centered

item.body: describe prints shape=rect and shape=ellipse but omits triangle, hexagon, parallelogram, circle, and star. They say nothing about what a node is, so the label must. actor, queue, document, cloud, and entity still print.
item.description: Why some new shapes are missing from describe.
item.label: describe hides geometric shapes

slide.takeaway: shape() sends nine library shapes and entity tables to new code; the original shapes keep their layout byte for byte.
